summary.text: Laura Andreson is the Democratic candidate for Tennessee House of Representatives District 63 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Republican Jake McCalmon.
Andreson is a physician and OB-GYN who ran for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Laura Andreson was born in Mohall, North Dakota, and graduated from Sawyer High School.
She earned a D.O. from Des Moines University in 2002 and completed her residency at the University of Minnesota in 2006.
Her career experience includes working as an OB-GYN.
Andreson won the Democratic primary for Tennessee House District 63 in 2024 and lost the general election to incumbent Jake McCalmon.
She advanced from the Democratic primary again on August 6, 2026.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a physician and a mother, and listed healthcare access and affordability, public schools, and responsible growth with attention to infrastructure and transportation as her key messages.
